# bitbucket_repository_user_permission (Resource)

Grants a user a permission level (read/write/admin) on a Bitbucket Cloud repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_repository_user_permission" "owner" {
  repository_slug = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  user            = "jcardenas"
  permission      = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission` (String) Permission level: "read", "write" or "admin".
- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository to grant access to.
- `user` (String) UUID (e.g. "{11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555}") or Atlassian account ID of the user to grant access to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug/user".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_repository_user_permission.owner payments-api/jcardenas
```
